description: SPIKE-ONLY (owner's request of 2026-11-24, plan 2026-11-24-spike-hub-panel, native-tauri.ts of the spike app): the page may start spikehub as the app's hidden child and stop it. The whole command line is fixed here, cmd /d /c .\spikehub.exe -browser=false; the page chooses only its working directory, the folder that holds spikehub.exe, media and results. cmd is there because Windows does not look for a relative program in the child's working directory; the plugin starts it without a console window and, with processGroup, in a job object, so that a kill ends cmd and spikehub together. The Downloads folder is where the page looks for the hub's folder first. TODO (Phase 4): the product's hub is a Windows service (§4.9), whose state the shell shows.
